title: 13,000 Signed Up to Fix India's Websites With AI! #shorts
description:
About 13,000 people registered for the Build What Moves India hackathon; 250 builds were shortlisted and 10 made the finale. RaktKhoj was among the reported prototypes, exploring blood bank and potential donor discovery. This is an independent competition presented by Varun Mayya in partnership with OpenAI, NOT an official government program. Prototype ≠ safe/operational emergency service; donor eligibility, compatibility and availability require independent professional verification.

Which would you redesign: BLOOD or VISA?
Event: https://buildwhatmovesindia.com/brief
Official event FAQ: https://buildwhatmovesindia.com/faq
Project reporting: https://www.financialexpress.com/life/technology-openai-goes-beyond-code-4361627/
All illustrated UI is original and conceptual, not product footage. Synthetic natural-style narrator distinct from Short 030.
